name: Wells Fargo & Company

sections.title: Diluted earnings per share by quarter
sections.callout: Q4 2025: diluted EPS of $1.62, up from $1.43 a year earlier.

footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows revenue going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses. Pre-tax income is derived as revenue − provision − noninterest expense. Net income is attributable to Wells Fargo.

Income statement and capital figures from Wells Fargo's Q4 2025 earnings release. Year-end total assets, long-term debt and equity as compiled by VCP Scanner (rounded); loans and deposits are full-year averages.
Diluted EPS by quarter as reported in the 10-Qs; fourth quarters are calculated (net income ÷ estimated diluted shares) because EPS does not add across quarters.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Wells Fargo's revenue grew 1.7% to $83.7B in 2025, as fee income rose 4.6% while net interest income was flat. The Federal Reserve lifted the asset cap that had limited the bank's growth since 2018.
Lower credit losses and flat expenses lifted net income 8.2% to $21.3B, and diluted EPS rose 16.6% to $6.26 as Wells Fargo bought back $18B of stock. Return on tangible equity rose to 14.6%.
highlights: The asset cap was lifted in 2025.
watch: Expenses were flat but still high at $54.8B.

revenueLine.cap: Net interest income was 57% of revenue; fee income grew 4.6%.
revenueLine.say: Net interest income made up 57 percent of revenue, and fee income grew 4.6 percent.
